criteria.note: Types in src/shared/domain/space.ts define units (METRIC_UNITS, fixed per metric), scope (MetricScope + SCOPE_REQUIRED_IDS), source (MetricSource), Measurement observed/estimated/missing, stable ids (mo/bl/as prefixes in src/core/ids.ts), policy, observation, baseline, grade input, grade and EvidenceRef. Fixtures src/core/space/fixtures/{observations,baselines,policy-v1}.json and rubric/*.json parse in `npx tsx scratch/DM-169/c1-contracts.ts` (48 PASS: 13 observations covering all three states, 8 baselines, policy equals SPACE_POLICY_V1, 5 grade inputs + expected grades; 14 malformed records refused, e.g. agent-sourced human_rating, negative/Infinity tokens, unit mismatch, attempt scope without attemptId, ungraded grade with a letter).

docs/space-grading.md specifies the 0–100 rule for each component, equal integer weight 1 (1/7 base), A≥90/B≥80/C≥70/D≥60/F<60, 10^-6 canonical precision with bands compared before display (display floored to 1 decimal), and worked complete (85.357143 → 85.3 B final), sparse (79.166667 → 79.1 C provisional, weights 1/4) and failure (uncapped 79.166667 → 59.0 F) examples plus too-sparse and unverified. `npx tsx scratch/DM-169/c2-rubric.ts` (33 PASS): boundaries 89.999999→B/90→A, 79.999999→C/80→B, 69.999999→D/70→C, 59.999999→F/60→D; 89.99 shows 89.9 B; all five fixtures regrade byte-for-byte and deterministically; inflated activity volume leaves the grade unchanged.

gradeSpace (src/core/space/rubric.ts): verification missing/pending → ungraded, no score/letter; confirmed mandatory failure → F with mandatory_failure cap at 59 (uncapped score kept); missing required component or estimated input → provisional; <4 scored → ungraded insufficient_coverage; every result lists coverage, base and effective weights (0 for missing), missing reasons. `npx tsx scratch/DM-169/c3-status.ts` (14 PASS): unverified fixture with A/C/E/T/K at 100 is ungraded; failing change F even with all other components 100; sparse score 79.166667 differs from missing-as-zero 45.238095 and missing-as-100 88.095238; estimated K → provisional; zero scope → missing, not 100.

src/core/space/baselines.ts: T/K need a budget (per ticket, version, revisionId, server frozenAt) or cohort (workType/size/risk = planned reasoning level, sampleSize ≥ 5, median, spread, members excluding the subject); frozenAt must be strictly before dispatchedAt; zero values refused; no eligible baseline → missing no_eligible_baseline (T/K missing, never 0 or 100). Order: budget, latest frozenAt, version, sample size, id (latest frozen wins before sample size, per the earlier review). `npx tsx scratch/DM-169/c4-baselines.ts` (13 PASS): 5 fixture subjects pick expected baselines with listed rejection reasons; a 1,000,000-token v3 budget saved 2 h after dispatch is rejected (frozen_after_dispatch) and K stays 92.5, yet applies to a later dispatch; frozen exactly at dispatch is refused; zero actual and unreported attempts give missing.

evidence.notes:
Design decisions to confirm: (1) S is optional (missing S drops out of weights but does not block Final); all other six are required. (2) Cohort risk = the planned reasoning level, since tickets carry no risk field. (3) Failure ceiling 59; display floors to one decimal so 89.99 shows 89.9 B. (4) An inherited sprint rating needs sharedWithTickets=true (explicit sharing). (5) Added id prefixes mo/bl/as to src/core/ids.ts (shared file) and updated the pinned-prefix test. (6) Commit made with a per-command identity (Dark Mechanicus worker (DM-169) <dm-worker@localhost>) because the worktree has no git user configured; no global config changed. artifacts.label: Policy v1 and reference grader gradeSpace

outputs.summary: Defined the SPACE grading and measurement contract (policy dm-space v1, a SPACE-informed Dark Mechanicus policy, not an official SPACE formula). Types in src/shared/domain/space.ts (units, scope levels with required ids, sources human/server/host/agent, observed/estimated/missing measurements, evidence refs, METRIC_DEFINITIONS with direct/proxy signal and allowed sources per metric, observations, budget and cohort baselines, policy, grade inputs, grades). Zod validation in src/core/space/contract.ts with parse* functions typed against the contract. New stable id prefixes mo (metric observation), bl (baseline), as (assessment) in src/core/ids.ts, so ids.test.ts pins them (its expected map moved to module scope to stay within max-lines-per-function). Reference grader gradeSpace and SPACE_POLICY_V1 in src/core/space/rubric.ts (7 components weight 1 each; integer micro-unit canonical precision; bands on canonical value; display floored to 1 decimal; Ungraded on missing/pending verification or <4 scored components; F cap at 59 on confirmed mandatory failure; Provisional on missing required or estimated components; S optional; missing never imputed). Baseline eligibility/selection in src/core/space/baselines.ts (budget before cohort, then latest frozenAt, version, sample size, id; frozenAt must be strictly before dispatch; cohorts matched on workType/size/risk=reasoning level, min sample 5, subject excluded; no eligible baseline = missing). Rubric doc docs/space-grading.md with direct-vs-proxy table and worked complete/sparse/too-sparse/failure/unverified examples; pointer section in docs/architecture.md. Checked-in fixtures in src/core/space/fixtures (observations, baselines, policy-v1, rubric/*.json with input+expected). Rerunnable demos in scratch/DM-169 (c1..c4). Downstream (DM-177) should extend gradeSpace, not write a second calculator; DM-170/171 must assign frozenAt and dispatchedAt from server records.
